name: Haru e to Tsuzuku Oka
source:
2026, winter.

After getting my teacher's license, I came to my first working place...
It was a very small school, located in a rural town.
A class of four students... and only four months to spend with them until the school closure.
What can I do in such a short period of time?
Me, the children, the principal, and the rest of this town.
Trying our best, heading to our own future.

And, eventually...

Spring would return.

[Translated from the [url=http://n-hsc.com/?page_id=287]official site[/url]]
